literal: Death having raged against even if comes, having united facing which stands strength, that indeed [is an] army.
translation: A true army is that which has the strength to stand united and face even Death, should it advance upon them in a rage.
modern: எமன் சினந்து தன் மேல் வந்தாலும், சிதறாமல் ஒன்றாகச் சேர்ந்து எதிர்த்து நிற்கும் வலிமை உடையதே சிறந்த படையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate courage and solidarity of a true army. The word 'கூற்று' (Death) represents the most terrifying and invincible foe imaginable. Even if Death itself were to advance upon them in fury, a great army will not scatter in fear. Instead, they will unite ('கூடி') and stand their ground ('எதிர் நிற்கும்'). The true mark of an army is this collective strength ('ஆற்றல்') to face certain doom without breaking ranks.
